title: An agent's turn whose binding's metadata sets a system prompt that is no text fails before it reads anything, with pydantic's validation error naming every setting the turn's context refuses
notes: Python: channels/_ai_context.py _turn_settings reads a resolved system prompt that is no text as AIContext reads it, before the turn reads it as a text (RMK-1237, maintainer's decision): AIContext(**settings) raises pydantic's ValidationError, each refused setting named in the model's order, ahead of the token budget's check. room-1 5; room-2 0 and the temperature 'hot', both named; room-3 false and the token budget '1200', the prompt's refusal first.
